PriorLearningEvaluation.name: PriorLearningEvaluation
PriorLearningEvaluation.description: Represents the evaluation of a learner's prior learning that can be used for a transfer.

AccountId.description: The account that's associated with the prior learning evaluation.

ContactId.description: The contact who's associated with the prior learning evaluation.

CurrencyIsoCode.description: The ISO code for the currency associated with the prior learning evaluation.

LastReferencedDate.description: The timestamp when the current user last accessed this record, a record related to this record, or a list view.

LastViewedDate.description: The timestamp when the current user last viewed this record or list view. If this value is null, the user might have only accessed this record or list view (LastReferencedDate) but not viewed it.

Name.description: The name of the prior learning evaluation.

OwnerId.description: The user who owns this record.

ParentPriorLearningEvalId.description: The prior learning evaluation record that's associated with all the prior learning evaluations generated in the same agent session.

Request.description: The JSON request that generated the prior learning evaluation.

Result.description: The JSON response containing the details of the prior learning evaluation.
